short_blurb: Remodels, additions & ADUs — licensed general contractor in Northridge.
local_note: Whether you're modernizing a kitchen, adding a primary suite, converting a garage, or building an ADU, Palm Crest Builders brings licensed, code-compliant construction to Northridge. As a Class B general building contractor we coordinate every trade under one contract and keep your project on schedule and on budget. We build throughout Northridge, including Northridge, CSUN area, Northridge Fashion Center area, and nearby neighborhoods.

faqs.q: Do you pull building permits in Northridge?
faqs.a: Yes — we handle plans, plan check, and permits through the Northridge building and safety department for every remodel, addition, and ADU, and we schedule all required inspections.

faqs.q: Can I build an ADU in Northridge?
faqs.a: In most cases, yes. Under California and Northridge rules, most single-family lots qualify for a detached, attached, or garage-conversion ADU. We handle feasibility, design, permits, and construction.

faqs.q: How long will my Northridge remodel or addition take?
faqs.a: It depends on scope — bathrooms typically run 3–5 weeks, kitchens 4–8 weeks, and room additions 2–4 months. We give you a firm schedule with milestones in your written estimate.
